_comment: Hand-maintained packs-per-box table (§3.2). NOT derivable from MTGJSON — WotC changes this by fiat. Feb-2025 DFT cutover drops Play Booster boxes from 36 to 30 packs; every other product line is flat. 'overrides' lets a specific set/product diverge (e.g. a Universes Beyond Collector Booster box) without touching the default table.
